text:
maria: Quick heads-up — starting a tiny wedge canary for search-ranked-v2 in ~15m. Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over ~30m. Owners: ajay (smoke) + noah (rollback). ETA start 2025-04-23T15:00:00Z.
ajay: ack, I'll grab the smoke window. what's the smoke checklist? :eyes:
maria: short checklist: 1) API responses sanity (top-5 results), 2) p50/p95 latency (<200ms/<500ms), 3) 5xx rate <0.05%. Also watch token cost delta. quick curl smoke below.
ajay: paste the curl pls
maria: ```
# smoke test
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"search-ranked-v2","input":"find best training dataset for user retention"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq '.choices[0].text'
```
noah: I'll standby for rollback. if p95 > 600ms or 5xx spike > 0.1% roll back immediately. Confirmed I can run the rollback script.
jean: tagging SRE: @sre-oncall can you watch infra metrics during the ramp? particularly queue length and GPU mem pressure.
sre-oncall: on it, will mute non-urgent alerts. I'll post if we see any queue backlog > 1000 or GPU mem > 90%.
maria: schedule: T+0m 1%, T+10m 5%, T+30m 20% — can we keep each step at least 5m to observe? also enabling KV cache warmup for canary.
ajay: 5m hold sounds good. I'll run a sample eval after 5m at each step (we have the eval harness ready).
noah: rollback script path: ops/rollbacks/rollback-search-ranked-v2.sh — tested locally. I can run with `./rollback-search-ranked-v2.sh --reason "perf regression"`
maria: thanks. if no objections I'll kick at T+15m. ping me 5m prior if anything blocks. :rocket: 
ajay: no blockers from infra. queued tests running now.
sre-oncall: infra green. ready to escalate if needed.
deploy-bot: canary started at 1746009900 — 1% traffic to search-ranked-v2, cohort selection: geo=US,web=mobile. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.ai/1746009900
maria: first-checks at T+5m. ajay/noah please post short thumbs (ok/problem) so we can proceed.
ajay: ok — smoke OK (top results look sane), latency stable. :thumbsup:
noah: looks ok from rollback side. no errors seen. :thumbsup:
maria: proceeding to 5% now.
deploy-bot: ramp to 5% at 1746009960 — monitoring group: latency,5xx,token-usage. Alerts suppressed for noise.
maria: excellent. will hold and reconvene at +10m to decide 20% step.
ajay: will post evaluation results at +10m.
